title: How to Make the Ultimate Cheesy Bean and Cheese Burrito
description: This video provides a detailed guide on assembling and cooking a savory bean and cheese burrito, focusing on proper heating techniques and ingredient choices. It emphasizes using Monterey Jack cheese and specific steps for rolling and cooking the tortilla.
summary: The video instructs viewers on how to prepare a bean and cheese burrito, highlighting three key ingredients: tortillas, leftover beans, and cheese. The preparation involves heating the tortilla directly over an open flame (using heat-proof gloves) to make it pliable. The assembly process requires placing the leftover beans on the tortilla, followed by generously adding grated Monterey Jack cheese. The cooking technique involves rolling the tortilla and then cooking it on a pan over medium heat, ensuring the seam is down first. The instructions detail the need to repeatedly flip and cook the burrito (about two minutes per side) until the cheese is fully melted, resulting in a "glorious, cheesy, delectable bite." The video also touches upon variations, suggesting ingredient experimentation for the dish.
